caps: The whole world bows | to the *RISING* sun.
*ONE* festival bows first | to the *SETTING* sun.
lines.tts: The whole world bows to the rising sun. One festival bows first, to the setting sun.

caps: *CHHATH.* | No priest. No idol. No temple.
Just a river, the sun, | and a fast of *36 HOURS.*
lines.tts: छठ. No priest. No idol. No temple. Just a river, the sun, and a fast of thirty-six hours.

caps: *DAY ONE:* Nahay Khay. | A holy dip,
then one pure meal: | rice, dal and lauki.
lines.tts: Day one: Nahaay Khaay. A holy dip, then one pure meal: rice, daal and lauki.

caps: *DAY TWO:* Kharna. | Fast all day.
At night: jaggery kheer | and roti, off a clay stove.
Then *36 HOURS.* | No food. | Not a drop of *WATER.*
lines.tts: Day two: Kharnaa. Fast all day. At night: jaggery kheer and roti, off a clay stove. Then, thirty-six hours. No food. Not a drop of water.

caps: *DAY THREE:* | Sandhya Arghya.
Waist-deep in the river, | a *SOOP* of fruit and thekua
is raised | to the *SETTING* sun.
lines.tts: Day three: Sandhyaa Arghya. Waist-deep in the river, a soop of fruit and thekuaa, is raised to the setting sun.

caps: *DAY FOUR:* | Usha Arghya.
Before dawn, they are back | in the cold water.
Waiting...
lines.tts: Day four: Ushaa Arghya. Before dawn, they are back in the cold water. Waiting.

caps: And then, | the sun *RISES.*
Only then | does the fast break.
lines.tts: And then, the sun rises. Only then does the fast break.

caps: And *CHHATHI MAIYA?* | She is *SHASHTHI DEVI,*
the guardian of children.
Folk songs call her | the Sun's own *SISTER.*
lines.tts: And छठी मैया? She is Shashthee Devi, the guardian of children. Folk songs call her, the Sun's own sister.

caps: The world salutes | whoever is *RISING.*
Chhath bows | to the one who *SETS,*
because he will | *RISE* again.
lines.tts: The world salutes whoever is rising. छठ bows to the one who sets, because he will rise again.

caps: Tell us your *GHAT,* | and say it with us:
*JAI CHHATHI MAIYA!*
lines.tts: Tell us your ghaat, and say it with us: Jai छठी मैया!
